第3章 不再给他们打电话（第1页）
他是公司里为数不多知道容辞和封庭深关系的人。
熟悉封庭深的人都知道，他的心不在容辞身上。
婚后，他对容辞很冷漠，很少回家。
为了接近并拿下封庭深，容辞选择进入封氏集团工作。
她最初的目标是成为封庭深的贴身秘书。
就是老爷子出面，也没办法让封庭深点头。
最后，容辞只好退而求次的留在了秘书部，成为了封庭深众多普通秘书之一。
一开始，姜哲还担心容辞进了秘书部后会把秘书部弄得鸡飞狗跳。
容辞虽然会利用职务之便接近封庭深，但也会分时机，更不会过火。
相反，可能是为了让封庭深对她刮目相看，容辞工作很认真，能力也很出色，不管是怀孕生子抑或是其他时候，她都跟着公司章程走，从来不搞特殊化。
几年下来，容辞成了秘书部的组长。
容辞对封庭深的感情他一直看在眼里。
说实话，姜哲从没想过容辞会辞职。
现在容辞会辞职，估计是她和封庭深之间发生了他不知道的事，以至于封庭深勒令她辞职。
容辞工作能力挺强，虽然可惜，姜哲还是公事公办道：“辞职信我收了，我会尽快安排人接替你的工作。”
姜哲忙了一会后，在线上给封庭深汇报工作。
在聊得差不多的时候，忽然想起了容辞辞职一事：“对了封总，关于——”

他虽然跟容辞说会尽快安排人接替她的工作，但具体什么时候让容辞走他还是想打探一下封庭深的意思。
如果封庭深想让容辞明天就不用到公司来了，那他一会就安排下去。
可话到了嘴边，又想起当初容辞入职时，封庭深就说过，容辞在公司的一切事宜都让他们按公司章程处理，不用特意跟他汇报。
这些年，在公司里，封庭深从来没主动过问过容辞的事。
平时在公司见到容辞，也是完全一副看陌生人的态度。
这些年，容辞表现突出，前两年他们打算给容辞升职前，考虑到封庭深对容辞的不喜，他们还特意在封庭深面前提了下。
意思是如果他不喜欢，这事就算了。
当时封庭深听了，皱着眉头，不耐烦的再度重申了一遍，说他不会干涉，让他们按章程走。
说以后关于容辞在公司的事，也别再问他。
见姜哲迟迟没开口，封庭深皱眉：“什么事？”
既然容辞辞职一事封庭深已经知道，但他却没有跟他主动提起，就说明这事在封庭深眼里根本不重要。
他这边还是像以往一样，按照公司规定处理就可以了。
中午，同事忽然拍了下容辞的肩膀。

Chapter 3 Stop calling them (page 1)
He is one of the few people in the company who knows the relationship between Rong Ci and Feng Ting.
Anyone who is familiar with Feng Tingshen knows that his heart is not with Rong Ci.
After marriage, he was very indifferent to Rong Ci and rarely went home.
In order to get close to and win over Feng Tingshen, Rong Ci chose to work in the Feng Group.
Her initial goal was to become Feng Tingshen's personal secretary.
Even if the old man comes forward, he can't make Feng Tingshen nod.
In the end, Rong Ci had no choice but to stay in the secretarial department and became one of Feng Tingshen's many ordinary secretaries.
At first, Jiang Zhe was worried that Rong Ci would cause chaos in the secretarial department after joining it.
Although Rong Ci will take advantage of his position to get close to Feng Tingshen, he will also use his timing and will not go overboard.
On the contrary, perhaps to impress Feng Tingshen, Rong Ci was very serious about her work and had excellent abilities. Whether she was pregnant or having a baby or at other times, she followed the company's regulations and never made any specializations.
A few years later, Rong Ci became the team leader of the secretarial department.
He had always seen Rong Ci's deep feelings for Feng Ting.
To be honest, Jiang Zhe never thought that Rong Ci would resign.
Now that Rong Cihui is resigning, it is probably because something happened between her and Feng Tingshen that he didn't know about, so Feng Tingshen ordered her to resign.
Rong Ci has a strong working ability. Although it is a pity, Jiang Zhe still said businesslikely: "I have accepted the resignation letter, and I will arrange someone to take over your job as soon as possible."
After Jiang Zhe was busy for a while, he reported his work to Feng Tingshen online.
When they were about to chat, he suddenly remembered Rong Ci's resignation: "By the way, Mr. Feng, about--"
Although he told Rong Ci that he would arrange someone to take over her job as soon as possible, he still wanted to find out what Feng Tingshen meant when he would let Rong Ci go.
If Feng Tingshen wanted Rong Ci not to come to the company tomorrow, he would make arrangements soon.
But when the words came to his lips, he remembered that when Rong Ci joined the company, Feng Tingshen said that all matters involving Rong Ci in the company would be handled in accordance with the company's articles of association, and there was no need to report to him specifically.
In these years, Feng Tingshen has never taken the initiative to ask about Rong Ci in the company.
When I usually see Rong Ci in the company, he always looks at him like a stranger.
In recent years, Rong Ci has performed outstandingly. Before they planned to promote Rong Ci in the past two years, considering Feng Tingshen's displeasure with Rong Ci, they specifically mentioned it in front of Feng Tingshen.
It means that if he doesn't like it, forget it.
At that time, Feng Ting listened deeply, frowned, and reiterated impatiently, saying that he would not interfere and let them follow the rules.
Don't ask him again about Rong Ci's work in the company.
Seeing that Jiang Zhe didn't speak for a long time, Feng Ting frowned deeply: "What's the matter?"
Since Feng Tingshen already knew about Rong Ci's resignation, but he didn't take the initiative to mention it to him, it showed that this matter was not important in Feng Tingshen's eyes.
On his side, it's still the same as before, just follow the company's regulations.
At noon, a colleague suddenly patted Rong Ci on the shoulder.
